name: read_file
description: Read a local file and return its text content (UTF-8). Truncates at 12000 chars. Returns error if path is a directory or doesn't exist.

name: write_file
description: Write content to a file, creating parent dirs if needed. OVERWRITES the entire file. High token cost because the AI must output the full file content. Best for creating new files only.

name: replace_file
description: Alias for write_file. Replaces the ENTIRE file content. Same high token cost. Avoid for partial edits.

name: delete_file
description: Delete a file or recursively delete a directory (uses shutil.rmtree for dirs). Irreversible.

name: list_directory
description: List directory contents sorted (dirs first, then files). Shows file sizes and dir markers. Read-only, no side effects.

name: get_system_info
description: Returns OS platform, Python version, and current working directory. Read-only.

name: search_file
description: Case-insensitive text search within a file or directory. Returns matching lines with file:line format. Supports recursive search and max_results limit (default 20). Read-only.

name: search_web
description: Web search using DuckDuckGo HTML scraping. No API key needed. Returns top results with titles and URLs. Fallback search option.

name: search_tavily
description: Web search using Tavily API. Requires saved API keys in api_accounts.lock. Tries multiple accounts with failover. Higher quality results than search_web.

name: fuzzy_apply_patch
description: Apply a unified diff patch with fuzzy matching. If exact line numbers drift, it searches ±50 lines around the expected position for the context. Also tries normalized matching (strips trailing whitespace, normalizes CRLF/LF). Supports multi-file patches, new file creation, and file deletion. Most resilient patch tool.

name: smart_replace_block
description: Find-and-replace a text block in a file with 3-tier matching: (1) exact string match, (2) normalized line endings (CRLF vs LF), (3) trailing whitespace stripped per line. Supports occurrence param for nth match. Best for single-file targeted replacements where you know the old text.

name: verify_file_content
description: Verify that a file contains expected_text and/or does not contain unexpected_text after making edits to confirm changes were successfully applied.

name: save_memory
description: Save important notes, decisions, user preferences, or architecture details into persistent long-term memory.

name: read_memory
description: Retrieve saved memories or notes by key, or list all saved memories if key is omitted.

name: delete_memory
description: Delete a specific memory by key when it is no longer needed.

name: replace_lines
rating: Best for exact line ranges (Low token)
description: Replace a 1-indexed line range [start_line, end_line] with new text. Very token-efficient because the AI only outputs the replacement text, not context. Requires accurate line numbers. Best when you know exact line numbers from read_file output.

name: replace_block
description: Basic find-and-replace of a text block. Requires EXACT string match (including whitespace, line endings). No fallback if match fails. Superseded by smart_replace_block which has fuzzy fallbacks. Keep off unless you need strict matching.

name: apply_patch
description: Apply a strict unified diff patch. Context lines must match EXACTLY at the specified line numbers. No fuzzy search, no normalization. Fails if AI-generated line numbers drift even by 1 line. Superseded by fuzzy_apply_patch. Keep off.

name: insert_after
description: Insert text immediately after an exact anchor string. Supports occurrence param for nth match. Good for adding new code after a known marker (e.g. after a function signature or import block). Requires exact anchor match.

name: delete_block
description: Delete an exact text block from a file. Supports occurrence param for nth match. Internally uses find-and-replace with empty replacement. Requires exact string match.

name: run_shell_command
description: Run a shell command via subprocess. Captures stdout+stderr. Has a configurable timeout. Use for git, pip, npm, build tools, etc.

name: run_powershell
description: Run a PowerShell command via 'powershell -Command'. Best for Windows-specific operations, registry, services, and complex scripting. Captures stdout+stderr.

name: request_follow_up
description: Request another AI turn for multi-step work. The AI calls this when it needs more turns to complete a task. Returns a reason string. No side effects.
